[[Lute of the Winter Sky]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Lute of the Winter Sky]]:''' Equipping this instrument allows you to hear the scattered notes of Hyrsam's music. Finds these motes of music and play this instrument to claim them, but beware their guardians.

This lute can only advance or find it's golden mote on reaper difficulty.
